title: BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the appropriations limit for 2026-27.
text:
[Council File 26-0600-S114]
[Items Noticed for Public Hearing]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the appropriations limit for 2026-27.
Recommendations for Council action:
1. ADOPT the following factors to calculate the appropriations limit for 2026-27:
a. Population Percent Change - City: -0.87 percent
b. Nonresidential New Construction: 9.55 percent
2. ADOPT $10,026,603,100 as the appropriations limit for 2026-27.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Administrative Officer reports that there is no fiscal impact in adopting the recommendations in the report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
